answer.text: For checking the battery voltage, the manual says to contact a Royal Enfield Authorised Service Centre or a battery service centre.
On the analog screen, the battery gauge has four segments, and each segment represents 1 V.
For example, two segments completely filled means 12.5 V, and up to three segments half filled means 13 V.

policy.text: Battery voltage checks are referred to a Royal Enfield Authorised Service Centre or a battery service centre.

watchouts.text: Do not hold the starter button down for long periods after the engine fails to start, because this drains the battery below 10 V.

disclaimers.text: The manual does not give a step-by-step way for a rider to measure the battery voltage.
The manual does not say how accurate the analog screen battery gauge is.
